name: understanding-kit
description: Check the minimum understanding needed for an owner's SDLC decisions through evidence-grounded adaptive micro-quizzes.

interface.shortDescription: Brief quizzes for the decisions you own
interface.longDescription: Explicitly start a role-aware understanding quiz from a task snapshot. Check necessary knowledge, distinguish diagnostic answers from immediate practice, and receive brief feedback without changing engineering artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Use $understanding-kit:pop-quiz to check the minimum understanding I need for my responsibilities in this task, using the available context snapshot.
